notes: Verified: go build/vet/gofmt clean; new Go tests (7 Postgres integration + 2 unit) run against a throwaway postgres:16 and pass; they exercise the production mcpAuthChain with a real RSA-signed fake IdP and assert on status/headers/body/log, so they would fail without the change. Full httpapi/oidcauth/apikeys packages pass; unrelated packages (teams, threads, sidebar, store, ws, webhooks, workitems) failed only with 'out of shared memory' under parallel package runs on the throwaway DB and pass serially — environment, not the PR. Webapp: tsc clean, MCPSettingsPage.test.tsx 5/5 pass.

Security review of the auth path: asymmetric-alg-only verifier (SkipClientIDCheck but SupportedSigningAlgs restricted), iss/exp/nbf via go-oidc, typ=ID/cnf/empty-sub refused, audience bound to resource or admin allow-list, only pre-linked active user_identities rows accepted (delete_at=0), principal is Restricted with admin scopes ∩ token scopes and RBAC intersects with live roles (rbac postgres also filters delete_at=0, so deferred approvals for deactivated SSO requesters are refused). WWW-Authenticate challenge is applied only on the /mcp route; tested that REST 401s stay clean. Challenge writer implements Flush/Unwrap for SSE.

Trade-off worth knowing (documented in ADMIN_GUIDE as the 'compat path'): when an admin lists a client id in mcp.oauth.audience instead of using an Audience mapper, a token for that client is valid on every moyro deployment in the same realm that lists it — RFC 8707 per-resource binding is only achieved via the mapper route.

Minor: nativeMCPChallenge adds a second mcp-settings DB read per /mcp request (nativeMCPGate already does one), even on key-only installs. Same pattern as existing gates; consider passing the loaded settings through context later.
Minor: AuthorizeApproved now looks up the channel before ResolveCurrent; behaviourally equivalent (both branches return false on failure).
Reverting is clean: no migrations; new settings live in the existing mcp JSON row under an 'oauth' key that older code ignores. docs/*.pdf regenerated as in prior release commits.
